{{Quote|There's&hellip;too many of them!|Lieutenant Telsij|audio=Telsij-TooMany.flac|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
'''Telsij''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] pilot and a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served in [[Gray Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gray Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], he flew as [[Gray Two]] in a [[Gray Squadron 2|Y-Wing]], acting as Colonel [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm's]] wingman. He was one of only four pilots to survive a [[Raid on the Imperial Academy of Carida|raid]] on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]]. His gunner at Endor was [[Karie Neth/Legends|Karie Neth]]. When [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] began to attack the Rebel starfighters in space, Telsij cried out that they were being overwhelmed. Despite the overwhelming numbers of Imperial fighters, the Rebellion emerged victorious.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
In Human culture, "Telsij" was a feminine first name.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[1999]], an action figure of Telsij was released by [[Hasbro]] as part of the "Rebel Pilots" Cinema Scenes set, but was incorrectly identified as [[Arvel Crynyd/Legends|Arvel Crynyd]].<ref name="POTF2">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|pack=Rebel Pilots|link=POTF2rebelpilots.asp}}</ref> Although the shape of the helmet included with the figure matches that worn by Telsij, the pattern on it was based on another helmet prop created for the film, which was later worn by Rebel pilot [[Till]] in the video game [[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire|''Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire'']].<ref name="The Hidden Empire">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire]]''</ref>

[[File:Telsij_flight_helmet_SWCostumes.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Telsij's [[Flight helmet/Legends|flight helmet]]]]
The name "Lieutenant Telsij" first appeared in a ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' set released by [[Decipher]] in [[2000]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Telsij}}</ref>

According to stage director Hilary Westlake, the actor who portrayed Telsij is likely to have been [[Eiji Kusuhara]]. Westlake was a close friend of Kusuhara, and wrote his obituary for ''The Guardian'' after his death in 2010. After viewing footage of Telsij's appearance in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']], Westlake told NPR that, "Albeit brief, I would say it is most certainly Eiji."<ref name="NPR">{{WebCite|url=https://www.npr.org/sections/codeswitch/2014/12/29/372670957/diversity-in-space-tracking-the-first-asian-pilot-in-the-star-wars-movies|text=Diversity In Space: Tracking The First Asian Pilot In The Star Wars Movies|author=Steve Haruch|date=2014-12-14|archivedate=20190518192028}}</ref>
